name: sketchpad-3d
description: Create, preview and export 3D models through conversation. Zero setup — OpenSCAD runs bundled via WebAssembly, with BOSL2 and fonts included.
long_description: Write OpenSCAD models with your AI assistant and see them instantly: inline previews with dimensions, labelled multi-view grids, turntable animations and a live 3D viewer in your browser. Export STL, 3MF (with colours), OBJ, SVG or DXF straight to a folder of your choice.

output_dir.title: Export folder
output_dir.description: Where exported models and saved .scad files go. Leave empty to use your Downloads folder.

auto_open_viewer.title: Open the 3D viewer automatically
auto_open_viewer.description: Open the interactive browser viewer on the first render.
